properties.name: Popol Vuh — Hero Twins
properties.summary: The Hero Twins, Hunahpu and Xbalanque, descended to the underworld Xibalba to avenge their father. Through cleverness they defeated the Lords of Death in ball games and trials. They were sacrificed, ground up, and thrown into a river, but regenerated. They tricked the lords into being sacrificed and rose as the sun and moon.

properties.name: Maya Creation — Maize People
properties.summary: The creator gods tried three times to make humans. Mud people dissolved, wood people were hollow and soulless. Finally, Xmucane ground white and yellow maize into dough, creating humans with blood and maize flesh. These humans were perfect — too perfect, so the gods clouded their vision to maintain divine authority.

properties.name: The Flood of the Wood People
properties.summary: In the second creation, the gods made humans from wood. These people could speak but lacked hearts and minds, showing no gratitude to their creators. The gods sent a great flood of black rain and resin. Animals and even their own tools attacked the wood people. Their descendants became monkeys.

properties.name: The Descent to Xibalba
properties.summary: Hun Hunahpu and his twin descended to Xibalba, the underworld, summoned by the Lords of Death who were angered by their ball-playing. They failed the tests — the Dark House, Cold House, Jaguar House, Fire House, and Bat House. They were sacrificed, and Hun Hunahpu's head was placed in a calabash tree.
